page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No margin notes, no footnotes, no catchword.

main_text.p: tendo ; quod sic probo, Hieronymus fa-tetur se septuaginta libellos Origenis Ho-mileticos in Latinum vertisse, Ruffinus ultrà 70. illum progressum esse scribit; Atqui juxta Viri docti supputationem ul-trà libellos 70. ab Hieronymo versos invenies, si triginta novem Homilias in Lucam annumeres, sepositis septem in Psalmos Tractatibus seu Homilijs [?] quarum meminit in Catalogo ; Ergo si triginta novem sunt in Lucam Homiliæ ut con-[?]tendit eruditus Pearsonius, non ultrà libellos 70. Origenis Homileticos transtulerit tantùm Hieronymus, sed ultrà 80. quod Ruffini & ipsius Hieronymi verbis contrarium est; Hieronymus enim septuaginta à se conversos fatetur, Ruffinus ultrà septuaginta illum transtulisse affirmat; ut hunc reperiat numerum Vir doctus, 14. Homilias in Ieremiam numerat, totidem in Ezechielem,novem in Esaïam, duas in Canticum Canticorum, triginta novem in Lucam, quas omnes si putas & in unum colligis, habebis numerum 78. & si addis septem in Psalmos Homilias, consurget numerus 85. qui cum numero Ruffiniano consistere nequit: Tamen quoniam ambigi non potest quin Ruffino notiores fuerint Hieronymi translationes quàm nobis , ita numerandi sunt libelli

page.notes: Long s is plain s throughout. "Homilijs" is partly blurred in the scan; the 'ij' is uncertain, so it is marked [?]. The initial glyph of "contendit" is blurred and the reading "con-" is uncertain, so it is marked [?]. The word "supputationem" is printed with a long s; it is transcribed with the standard spelling. Printed spacing before semicolons ("tendo ;", "Ergo si", "Catalogo ;") is kept as printed. "Ezechielem,novem" and "Esaïam" are printed without a space and with a diaeresis, and are kept as printed. The paragraph runs unbroken across the whole page because no line is indented.
